decision_reason: Split-K COLLAPSED small/medium-M: the split-K band 16..256 fell to ~0.27-0.42x (was ~0.47-0.65x in c004). That dwarfs any serial-K latency saving. This FALSIFIES H7: the small-M floor is NOT under-occupancy along K; it is dominated by fixed per-launch cost + the single required L2 pass of B, and split-K only ADDS traffic. The band shapes are exactly the score's center of mass, so overall geomean dropped 0.58->0.38. Non-split shapes (tiny M<16: M=8 0.56, M=15 0.59; large M=8192 0.94, M=972 0.86) held/rose as expected since they used the c004 path. REJECT; reverted solution.py to the c004 design.
